column1: # Real-game integration test manifest (used by tools/fetch_games.sh and ./test.sh games).
# Columns (TAB separated; '#' lines and blank lines are ignored):
#   name     DOS name, 1-8 chars of A-Z 0-9 _
#   source   a file in test/games/ (committed), or an http(s) URL (downloaded)
#   sha256   SHA-256 of the source file (checked for both kinds)
#   license  SPDX license of the game
#   author   author of the game
#   page     web page of the game (license and author are checked here)
#   frames   number of frames to run (P386_FRAMES)
#   xfail    "-" = game must pass. Otherwise the exact serial text that is
#            expected (the test prints XFAIL; XPASS when the game works).
#   note     why the game fails (missing feature), or "-"
# LICENSE RULE: commit a game here only if its license allows redistribution.
# Texts of the licenses are in test/games/licenses/. All other games are
# downloaded into cache/games/ (git-ignored) and are never committed.
# A .p8 source is converted to .p8.png with tools/mkcart.py. This tool ignores
# __sfx__ and __music__, so the games run without sound data.
# ---- committed (permissive license) ----
PIKORALL
SHMUP
ISHIDO
NUDGE
# ---- downloaded (not redistributable here) ----
# PICO-Crate: the repository is Unlicense, but the cart holds music by Gruber
# (Pico-8 Tunes Vol. 1) with its own license. So the cart stays out of the repo.
CRATE
